SessionStart._comment: cost-router routing-status banner. Prints a one-line status showing active model tiers and remaining Opus budget. Suppressible via COST_ROUTER_BANNER=off. Matcher covers startup/resume/clear/compact (compact included: cost-router banner output is small and useful after compaction). Output kept well under the 10K hook ceiling.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: cost-router per-prompt classifier. Classifies the incoming prompt into THINK/DO/SCOUT and injects a one-line advisory nudge. No LLM call — pure keyword heuristic. Suppressible via COST_ROUTER_AUTOROUTE=off. UserPromptSubmit hooks have no matcher (matcher field is ignored per this repo's convention).
